acceptance_rule: Registry coverage is not integration acceptance. Every accepted row requires observed runtime behavior, conservation, provenance, and explicit philosophy review.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Acquire a measured element sample from an exact source or balanced separation.
role_contracts.use_contract: Use the element identity and isotope state in analysis or a balanced reaction.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Recover, transform, stabilize, or dispose of the measured matter with provenance intact.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Acquire a measured compound from a balanced reaction or fixed natural source.
role_contracts.use_contract: Use the compound formula and phase in analysis or a balanced reaction.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Recover reagents, transform products, or route declared waste without losing provenance.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Produce powder by a declared grinding, precipitation, or separation transaction.
role_contracts.use_contract: Meter the powder into chemistry or TCon feed according to its exact composition.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: React, remelt, reclaim, or contain the powder as declared hazardous waste.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Cast one ingot-equivalent through TCon-owned metallurgy.
role_contracts.use_contract: Use the exact metal as bulk stock or a property-qualified component.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Remelt through TCon or reclaim it without creating matter.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Cast or divide one ninth of an ingot-equivalent through TCon-owned metallurgy.
role_contracts.use_contract: Use the exact metal for measured small-stock work.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Remelt or recombine through a mass-conserving TCon transaction.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Cast nine ingot-equivalents through TCon-owned metallurgy.
role_contracts.use_contract: Use the exact metal as dense bulk stock and for property-qualified construction.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Remelt through TCon into the same conserved material state.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Press one cast metal stock unit using Create shaping after TCon metallurgy.
role_contracts.use_contract: Use the exact plate in property-qualified fabrication.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Remelt through TCon or recycle through an explicitly balanced route.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Form the polymer into sheet stock through declared pressure and heat processing.
role_contracts.use_contract: Use the exact polymer sheet for chemical-resistant fabrication.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Mechanically reclaim or route it to declared polymer waste.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Fill the registered container from the exact chemical phase with conserved quantity.
role_contracts.use_contract: Transport or meter the sealed chemical without substituting its identity.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Drain, recapture, or safely release it into the authoritative phase simulation.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Enter the world through a conserved phase transfer from a container or machine.
role_contracts.use_contract: Provide the exact local chemical phase and its hazards to the authoritative simulation.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Capture, react, disperse, or migrate the same conserved matter exactly once.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Charge a sealed noble-gas lamp made from the exact registered species.
role_contracts.use_contract: Provide powered spectral illumination and assay evidence for that species.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Recover the gas or route the sealed lamp through declared hazardous disposal.

role_contracts.entry_contract: Craft or receive the ChemLib periodic reference instrument.
role_contracts.use_contract: Inspect the canonical species, isotope, source, hazard, and property records.
role_contracts.conclusion_contract: Retain or recycle the reference without treating it as chemical matter.
